summary: The 13-item set is publishable and sits within the 7-13 target. Lead coverage is the OpenAI Jalapeño chip launch (item_2069770172802773292, official) paired with a genuinely distinct analytical angle (item_2069857412660801738, claim it was designed by Codex/GPT); these are same-event/different-angle rather than redundant, flagged for transparency. The reserve gdb tweet covers the same Jalapeño story and is correctly left in reserve. OpenAI appears twice (chip + GPT-5.5 Instant) which is within the allowed cap of 2 distinct stories, so not overrepresented. Two low-engagement items rest on a single secondary account paraphrasing an unverified claim with no primary link: item_2069841192309981661 (VaibhavSisinty, an unrecognizable 'Qwen-AgentWorld' Alibaba release) and item_2069749962871844940 (_avichawla speculative-decoding claim, ~6.4K views, 'reportedly', no source). Both are kept but flagged as source_traceability_failure, and a targeted additional Twitter search is requested to find a more traceable primary or corroborating source for the Alibaba open-source agent story. No hard duplicates require replacement.
